user.title: Custom Device Page Components
user.description: Adds cards to device pages. Everything it shows is read-only, and only administrators see device pages. You can add your own components afterwards with **Add component**.

data.color_temp_enabled: Color temperature box on light devices
data.color_temp_models: Only these models (empty = every color-temperature light)
data.bindings_enabled: Zigbee bindings (ZHA): Bound to / Bound from / Read bindings

data_description.related_order: Cards are sorted by this number; custom components default to 10.
data_description.color_temp_models: Pick models, or type a model or model ID.
data_description.bindings_enabled: Reads binding tables only when you press a button. Uses ZHA internals, so a ZHA update can break this part on its own.

data.confirm: Remove the join and everything that uses it

data_description.value: Used when 'Compare with' is 'A value I type'. For 'is one of', separate values with commas.

group_by.title: Group rows
group_by.description: Rows with the same values in these columns become one row. Shown columns must be grouped or be summaries.

data.limit: Show at most this many rows

data.columns: Columns to show, in order (up to 8)
data.link_type: Clicking a row's first cell opens

data_description.columns: The first column is the row's link. In List style the other columns show as small grey lines under it.

add_action.title: Add a row action
add_action.description: Each row gets a button that runs a Home Assistant action as the person who presses it. Actions that remove, reset, purge, restart, install firmware or run code are not offered. Actions marked (confirm) always ask before running.

devices.title: Which device pages
devices.description: Leave a field empty to not restrict by it. Fields are combined with AND; choices within a field with OR.

error.link_column_required: Choose the column whose value the link uses.
error.target_not_grouped: With grouping, the target column must be one of the grouped columns.
error.invalid_query: The component can't be saved yet; fix the problem shown below.

check_reload.name: Check and reload device page card

attach_failed.title: Device page card could not attach
attach_failed.description:
A browser on Home Assistant {ha_version} could not add the Custom Device Page Components card to a device page ({reason}). This version was tested with Home Assistant {tested}. Device pages still work; only the extra card is missing.

Update Custom Device Page Components when a new release is available, then press **Check and reload device page card** and refresh the browser.
